annotations.title: Working Load, Barbell Plates & Karvonen Zone 2 Calculator

description: Calculate prescribed working load for a target `reps @ RPE` from a reference set (accounting for full bodyweight system load on `pull_up`, `chin_up`, and `dip`), exact gym barbell plate pairs per side, and Tanaka + Karvonen Heart Rate Reserve Zone 2 bpm. Stateless public calculator (no auth required). Use for session load/plate prescription and aerobic Zone 2 HR targets; to rank a lift against population strength tiers (`untrained` to `elite`), use `strength_benchmark` instead.

age.description: Athlete age in years (14–90) for Tanaka HRmax estimation (`208 - 0.7 * age`).

bar_weight_kg.description: Empty Olympic barbell weight in kg (typically 20 kg standard or 15 kg women's bar).

bodyweight_kg.description: Athlete bodyweight in kg (>35 and <220), added to belt load on weighted calisthenics.

lift.description: Target compound lift (`pull_up`, `chin_up`, and `dip` include bodyweight in system load).

max_hr.description: Optional lab- or field-measured HRmax in bpm (overrides Tanaka age formula when set).

ref_reps.description: Repetitions completed in the reference set (1–20).

ref_rpe.description: Perceived exertion RPE of the reference set (5.0–10.0, where 10.0 = 0 reps in reserve).

ref_weight_kg.description: Reference set external load in kg (ADDED belt load for `pull_up`, `chin_up`, `dip`).

rest_hr.description: Morning resting heart rate in bpm (32–110) for Karvonen Heart Rate Reserve zones.

sex.description: Biological sex (`male` or `female`) used for strength context.

target_reps.description: Desired repetitions per working set to prescribe load for (1–20).

target_rpe.description: Desired effort RPE for the prescribed working set (5.0–10.0).

name: plates_zone2

app_url.description: Deep link to inspect this calculation interactively in STRUGGL.

connect_url.description: URL to connect a stateful STRUGGL athlete ledger via OAuth 2.1 or token.

e1rm_total_kg.description: Total system estimated 1RM in kg (barbell or bodyweight + belt).

heart_rate_reserve.description: Heart Rate Reserve (`HRmax - HRrest`) in bpm.

is_bodyweight_lift.description: True when athlete bodyweight was folded into system e1RM math.

karvonen_z2_max.description: Upper aerobic Zone 2 cap in bpm (Karvonen HRR).

karvonen_z2_min.description: Lower aerobic Zone 2 target in bpm (Karvonen HRR).

max_reps_at_target_load.description: Predicted reps to failure (RPE 10) at the prescribed weight.

measured_or_tanaka_max_hr.description: Measured HRmax or Tanaka (`208 - 0.7 * age`) estimate in bpm.

methodology.description: Peer-reviewed sports-science equation and STRUGGL pillar provenance.

naive_watch_z2_min.description: Naive `220 - age` %HRmax Zone 2 floor for error comparison.

onboarding.description: OAuth 2.1 connector metadata explaining what longitudinal state unlocking adds.

pct_of_e1rm.description: Prescribed intensity as a percentage of system e1RM.

plate_breakdown.description: Exact Olympic plate pairs per side of the barbell.

prescribed_added_kg.description: Prescribed external bar or dip-belt load in kg (rounded to gym increments).

prescribed_total_kg.description: Prescribed total system load in kg.

rpe_matrix.description: Reference RPE x rep load table derived from the athlete's e1RM.

z2_bpm_gained.description: Ceiling bpm correction vs naive `220 - age` formulas.

z2_comparison_summary.description: Summary comparing Karvonen HRR Zone 2 against naive watch defaults.

title: Working Load, Barbell Plates & Karvonen Zone 2 Calculator
